name: ERYNGIUM AQUATICUM
key_symptoms: Cough, with sense of constriction. Smarting in throat and larynx.
guiding_symptoms: Cough, with sense of constriction. Smarting in throat and larynx.
respiratory_symptoms: Cough, with sense of constriction. Smarting in throat and larynx.
urinary_symptoms: Tenesmus of bladder and urethra. Difficult and frequent micturition. Pain behind pubes. Spasmodic stricture. Renal colic (Pareira; Calc). Congestion of kidneys with dull pain in back, running down the ureters and limbs. Irritable bladder from enlarged prostate gland, or from pressure of uterus.

source.title: ERYNGIUM AQUATICUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
